newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Explorers Index rises slightly.
newsitem.headline: Australian Explorers Index rises slightly.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index edged up four points or 0.12 percent in the week to Friday. The All Ordinaries Index rose 2.60 percent.
Apr 18 Apr 11 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.

Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said a lower gold price, the Western Australian gold royalty, the Busang-related fallout and the strong Australian dollar weighed heavily on the explorers sector in the past week.
"Despite this, the Explorers Index edged 4 points higher as the 'spec' market was pushed by discovery news," Colgan said.
Junior partners in Mt Kare in Papua New Guinea, Carpenter Pacific and Ramsgate Resources, traded sharply higher after their Canadian partner released spectacular drilling results from the project.
Carpenter closed up 19.5 cents at 38 cents on Friday after it announced its Mount Kare mine was Porgera-like. Ramsgate closed up 3.7 cents at 9.5 cents on Friday.
"Troy Resources also had good news from their Cornishman joint venture with Sons of Gwalia Ltd," Colgan said.
